notes.title: Become a Star is available now with 20% discount!
notes.notes:
[b]Save 20%[/b] on B[b]ecome a Star[/b] when this VR rhythm game launches early access.

Play as a musician on his journey to success in this virtual reality rhythm game! Choose your instrument ([b]guitar or drums[/b]) and your concerts on stage ([b]indoor and outdoor[/b]) and feel the crowd vibrate to the rhythm of original songs!

We're already working on the first Update, which will include a full Leaderboard...

notes.title: Become A Star Early Access
notes.notes:
The early access release date for Become a Star. Our first game!
The date is September 5.

We're [b]sure you'll enjoy playing[/b] this virtual reality game.

You'll be able to play as a musician on stage, and feel the crowd vibrate and cheer you on!

For this early access, you've already got 4 locations ([b]indoor/outdoor[/b]), a [b]dozen music tracks[/b] and, of course, the 2 instruments ([b]guitar and drums[/b]). And you'll be able to play as Victor or Kala!

We'll be adding [b]new locations and new music on a regular basis[/b]. The interface will also be translated into as [b]many languages[/b] as possible.

[b]Please add the game to your Whishlist[/b], it helps us enormously in terms of visibility on Steam.

Don't hesitate to [b]join us on our discord[/b]: [url=https://discord.gg/Bt9kCmKCHb]https://discord.gg/Bt9kCmKCHb[/url]

See you soon!
